advance_flags: Any connection, read-only ones included: a watermark is the connection's own bookkeeping, never a write to the vault. Only ever moves the caller's own, forward, never past the vault's latest entry
changes_since: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults (read-only is enough)
checkin_step: The step's own holder, from the same connection, with its secret and fence; nobody else
claim_path: Whoever could write the path: an owner's or editor's agent with read-write access, or a path's named owner, canon or open; a read-only connection can't claim
claim_step: Whoever could write the plan's path: an owner's or editor's agent with read-write access, or a path's named owner. A read-only connection or a viewer can't claim
comment_on_proposal: An owner's or editor's agent with read-write access; viewers and read-only connections can't comment
complete_step: The step's own holder, from the same connection, with its secret and fence; nobody else
create_vault: An agent whose connection reaches all its person's vaults with read-write access; the person owns the new vault
delete_file: An owner's or editor's agent with read-write access, for open files only
list_claims: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults (read-only is enough)
list_files: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults (read-only is enough)
list_flags: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults, read-only ones included; never marks anything shown
list_links: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults (read-only is enough); name and url only, never the credential
list_my_feedback: Any connection; shows only its person's feedback, with the operator's replies, and never the text of what was typed in the web UI
list_proposals: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults (read-only is enough)
list_subscriptions: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults, read-only ones included; shows only its person's own watched paths
list_threads: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults (read-only is enough). Every member reads every thread, side threads included
list_variables: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults; pushes waiting for a person are shown to owners' and editors' read-write agents. Never values
list_vaults: Any connection or token; a read-only one shows you as viewer
open_thread: An owner's or editor's agent with read-write access; viewers and read-only connections can't open one
post_message: An owner's or editor's agent with read-write access, also to resolve or reopen a thread; viewers and read-only connections can't post
propose: An owner's or editor's agent with read-write access
read_file: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults (read-only is enough)
read_proposal: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults (read-only is enough)
read_thread: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults (read-only is enough)
register_work_plan: Whoever could write the plan file's path: an owner's or editor's agent with read-write access, or a path's named owner. A read-only connection or a viewer can't register
release_claim: The claim's own holder, from the same connection, with its secret and fence; nobody else
release_step: The step's own holder, from the same connection, with its secret and fence; nobody else
renew_claim: The claim's own holder, from the same connection, with its secret and fence; nobody else
revise_proposal: The proposer's agent (the person whose agent proposed counts as the proposer), with read-write access
search: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults (read-only is enough)
send_feedback: Any connection, read-only ones included: it sends feedback to the people who run this Reliquary and writes nothing to a vault. A vault it names must be within the connection
work_plan_status: Any member's agent, within its connection's vaults (read-only is enough)
write_file: An owner's or editor's agent with read-write access, for open files only
